# Stage325-B — Exact two-block witness against indefinite single-block Pareto continuation

2026-10-31. Classification: PORTABLE_AUTHOR_COUNTEREXAMPLE / EXACT_FRACTION_EXECUTED / UNREVIEWED / NOT_ADMITTED. This is a new exact comparison in the *auxiliary* three-visit Bernoulli BRC observer model. It does not prove the first global optimizer switch, optimality of the two-block witness, a native X6 dynamical realization, or independent mathematical acceptance.

## Frozen inputs and status
GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE_V1 canonical main `8213df12edc1ce2684ad086a529b3d21803d782c` (bootstraps, original P000 blob `770e1b157fc10aab7b25d80c2cd52d6fcd07c9dc`, ACTIVE worldview, math and BRC policy); Enterprise Math main `5bd6b64a60e9d8c6df4a6a6b501229b6b2755d48` (P000 V5, X6 world and portable protocol). Scientific ancestor Stage324-B `a9b6f58bd0d1b474e2190d3628babf46dd3fedb3`, with Stage307-B.2, Stage315-B, Stage316-B and Stage317-B author-only reductions conditionally retained.

The model has two positive hidden sources, eight locked Bernoulli ports, three future visits, public observer (W,Y) and tagged observer (S,J,W,Y). Set `B_k(z)=z^k(1-z)^(3-k)`, `p=(61,21,9,9)/160`, `r_k(x,y)=(4/5)B_k(x)+(1/5)B_k(y)-p_k`, `d(x,y)=1/2 sum binom(3,k)|r_k(x,y)|`, and `b=(5/16)d`. Define `D_3(a,z)=1/2 sum binom(3,k)|B_k(a)-B_k(z)|` and
`c(x,y)=[63D_3(1/4,x)+D_3(3/4,x)+9D_3(1/4,y)+7D_3(3/4,y)]/256`.
The named auxiliary reduction gives the full eight-rate objectives `P=b(x,y)+b(x',y')`, `T=33/1024+c(x,y)+c(x',y')`. Let `(x*,y*)` denote the unique Stage307-B.2 minimizer, with `r_0=r_1=0`, and strict brackets
`231083940855521/10^15 < x* < 231083940855522/10^15`,
`555508857277/10^12 < y* < 555508857278/10^12`.
Put `beta*=b(x*,y*)`.

## New exact comparison theorem
Set `X=63/250` and define `Y` to be the unique real root of `r_1(X,Y)=0` in
`61157/100000 < Y < 61158/100000`. Set `epsilon_0=b(X,Y)-beta*` and `q=(6/25,29/50)`. Then
`7/1000 < epsilon_0 < 71/10000`,
`b(x*,y*)+b(X,Y)-2b(q) > 1/1000`,
`c(x*,y*)+c(X,Y)-2c(q) > 3/4000`.
Thus at public budget `P_min+epsilon_0=beta*+b(X,Y)`, the admissible two-block tuple `(q,q)` has strictly smaller tagged cost than the specific analytic continuation of Stage324's one-block right `r_1=0` tuple `((x*,y*),(X,Y))`, with public-feasibility slack >1/1000 and tagged improvement >3/4000. Consequently that *specific* branch formula cannot remain the global Pareto formula through all larger budgets: departure occurs by some `epsilon<=epsilon_0<71/10000` (Stage324's proven interval already covers `epsilon<=1/5000`, conditionally on its author lemmas). The witness is **not** certified to be a global minimizer; another one-block branch may beat both choices earlier.

## Proof and executable certificate
`r_1(X,y)=(4/5)X(1-X)^2+(1/5)y(1-y)^2-21/160`; its derivative `(1/5)(1-y)(1-3y)` is strictly negative for `1/3<y<1`. Exact evaluations give
`r_1(X,61157/100000)=2407836893/5000000000000000>0`,
`r_1(X,61158/100000)=-104305461/625000000000000<0`.
Hence Y exists and is unique. X>x*, Y>y*. The implicit rightward curve from (x*,y*) to (X,Y) has `r_1x>0` for x<1/3 and `r_1y<0` for y>1/3; it is the specified right continuation. **All public and tagged word-law absolute values are evaluated anew:** `r_3` and the `D_3(3/4,y)` word-sign chamber may switch along this extended curve. The former Stage324 fixed-sign derivative formulas are not extrapolated.

The adjacent Fraction-only checker provides rigorous real-interval enclosures. For each rational interval of z, bound `B_k(z)` using its endpoint values and the sole possible interior stationary point `k/3` for k=1,2. For `v in [l,u]`, `max(0,l,-u)<=|v|<=max(|l|,|u|)`. Positive rational linear combination preserves inclusion. Apply these operations to the algebraic (x*,y*) brackets, the Y root bracket, and exact rational q. Strict exact comparisons prove all three assertions over every real value in the declared brackets, not a sampled grid. Execute `python REPRO_STAGE325B.py`; `REPRO_STAGE325B_EXECUTED_STDOUT.txt` is the actual exact execution trace, ending `STAGE325B_TWO_BLOCK_COUNTEREXAMPLE_TO_SINGLE_BLOCK_CONTINUATION_EXACT_PASS`.

## BRC and unfinished question
Actual BRC reuse retains provenance-bearing source blocks, distinguishes public-total from source-tagged observers and compares the *full joint three-visit word laws*. The derived result concerns this explicitly typed external observer and not all possible native spatial observations. Find the first genuine global departure in `(1/5000,71/10000)` and classify whether it arises at a public residual-sign transition, a tagged-word-sign transition, a different one-group branch or a true budget split. Only global competitor exclusion certifies the actual first switch. Remaining native-transfer obligations: P000 six signed X6 steps with ordered path provenance; an explicitly embedded three-dimensional slice with third-coordinate semantics; triadic closure; separately typed time; registered lossless six-nonnegative-field Cell address. No independent Driver or Foundation admission has occurred.
